name: session-coordination
description: Per-session CLI and sidecar control paths that declare work to Concordia, apply confirmed provider settings, and keep optional observability outside the control dependency chain.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-coordination domain: task declaration remains available independently of optional observability artifacts.
